verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile Git client, so reviewing pull requests on a phone is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents listing, viewing, commenting on, or approving pull requests. Diff viewing, image comparison and hunk staging are adjacent features for local changes, and docs-19 mentions creating unspecified "these" for hosting providers without naming PR review.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go
